SCI-RD-F00-Q01.text: Read the sentence and the question on the card. Then tap the picture that answers it.

SCI-RD-F00-Q02.text: What does the card ask? Read it all the way through, then tap the picture that answers its question.

SCI-RD-F00-Q03.text: A short sentence and a question are waiting for you. Read them, then tap the picture that fits.

SCI-RD-F00-Q04.text: There's a sentence and a question on the card. Read them both, then tap the matching picture.

SCI-RD-F00-Q05.text: Which picture answers the question on the card? Read it to yourself, then tap it.

SCI-RD-F00-Q06.text: Have a read of what the card says. Then tap the picture that answers the question.

SCI-RD-F00-Q07.text: Read the sentence on the card carefully, then the question after it. Tap the picture that answers it.

SCI-RD-F00-Q08.text: Take a moment to read the card. Then tap the picture that answers the question at the end.

SCI-RD-T01-Q01.text: There's a short science fact on the card. Read it to yourself, then tap the picture that shows what the fact says.

SCI-RD-T01-Q02.text: Your clue is the fact written on the card. Read it closely, then look at the three pictures and tap the one that matches it.

SCI-RD-T01-Q03.text: Take a moment to read the fact on the card. Which picture shows the same idea? Tap it when you are ready.

SCI-RD-T01-Q04.text: In your own time, read the sentence on the card. Then find the picture that fits it best, and tap it.

SCI-RD-T01-Q05.text: This fact is a little longer. Read every word, then tap the picture that matches what it tells you.

SCI-RD-T01-Q06.text: Three pictures are waiting below the card. Read the fact carefully first, then tap the picture that shows what you read.

SCI-RD-T01-Q07.text: Think of yourself as a fact checker. Read the fact on the card, compare it with each picture, and tap the one that agrees with it.

SCI-RD-T01-Q08.text: Go slowly, word by word, as you read the card. When you know what it says, tap the picture that tells the same thing.

SCI-RD-T01-Q09.text: Ready for a longer fact? Read the whole card, even the tricky words. Then tap the picture that matches it.

SCI-RD-T01-Q10.text: Imagine you're making a picture book, and the fact on the card needs the right picture. Read it, then tap the one that fits.

SCI-RD-T02-Q01.text: Read the sentence on the card. Is it true, or is it false? Tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T02-Q02.text: Here's a statement to check. Read it carefully and decide: true or false?

SCI-RD-T02-Q03.text: Does the sentence on the card match what you know about the world? Read it, then tap true or false.

SCI-RD-T02-Q04.text: Some sentences are right and some are not. Read this one closely, then tap true or false.

SCI-RD-T02-Q05.text: Treat the card like a claim you need to check. Every word counts. Is it true or false?

SCI-RD-T02-Q06.text: What does the card claim? Read it all the way through, then tap true or false.

SCI-RD-T02-Q07.text: Take your time with this sentence. When you've decided whether it's right, tap true or false.

SCI-RD-T02-Q08.text: Careful reading first, then make your call: true or false?

SCI-RD-T02-Q09.text: Imagine a friend wrote this sentence in their science notebook. Read it. Did they get it right? Tap true or false.

SCI-RD-T02-Q10.text: Here's a sentence to think about. Read it all the way to the end, then decide whether it's true or false.

SCI-RD-T03-Q01.text: There's a word on the card for you to read. Once you've read it, tap the picture it describes.

SCI-RD-T03-Q02.text: Read the science word on the card. Then look at the three pictures and tap the one that shows it.

SCI-RD-T03-Q03.text: One word, three pictures. Read the word on the card, then tap the picture that matches it.

SCI-RD-T03-Q04.text: Can you read the word on the card? Sound it out if you like, then tap the picture that goes with it.

SCI-RD-T03-Q05.text: Look closely at all three pictures before you choose. First read the word on the card, then tap the picture it names.

SCI-RD-T03-Q07.text: This science word is a bit longer. Read it in parts if that helps, then tap the picture that shows what it means.

SCI-RD-T03-Q08.text: What does the word on the card mean? Read it, think it over, then tap the picture that shows it.

SCI-RD-T03-Q09.text: Here's a big science word to read. Break it into chunks, read it, then tap the picture that shows its meaning.

SCI-RD-T03-Q10.text: Imagine the word on the card is a secret password. Read it, work out what it means, and tap the picture that matches.

SCI-RD-T04-Q01.text: Two of the three words on the card belong together. Read them all, then tap both of those.

SCI-RD-T04-Q02.text: Look for a connection. Read all three words, find the two that are linked, and tap them both.

SCI-RD-T04-Q03.text: Which two words on the card go together? Read each one, then tap the pair.

SCI-RD-T04-Q04.text: Three words, one pair. Read them carefully and tap the two that are connected.

SCI-RD-T04-Q06.text: How might these words be related? Read them, then tap the two that go together.

SCI-RD-T04-Q07.text: One word on the card doesn't fit with the others. Read them all, then tap the two that do belong together.

SCI-RD-T04-Q08.text: Give yourself a moment to read the three words. When you spot the two that belong together, tap both.

SCI-RD-T04-Q09.text: Pair-finding time. Read the three words, then tap the two that make a team.

SCI-RD-T04-Q10.text: Imagine two of these words are best friends and one is a stranger. Read them all, then tap the two friends.

SCI-RD-T05-Q01.text: Read the label on the card. Then tap the part of the picture that the label names.

SCI-RD-T05-Q02.text: There's a label word on the card. Read it, then find the matching part and tap it.

SCI-RD-T05-Q03.text: Which part does the label name? Read it, look closely at the choices, and tap the one that matches.

SCI-RD-T05-Q04.text: Can you read the label? Once you know what it says, tap the part it belongs to.

SCI-RD-T05-Q05.text: Check each choice carefully on this one. Read the label, then tap the part that matches it.

SCI-RD-T05-Q06.text: In your own time, read the word on the label. Then tap the part of the picture it describes.

SCI-RD-T05-Q07.text: Here's a labelling job. Read the label on the card, then tap the part it matches.

SCI-RD-T05-Q08.text: Once you've read the label, picture where that part would be, then tap the choice that matches it.

SCI-RD-T05-Q09.text: Explorer job: read the label on the card, then tap the part it names. Take your time.

SCI-RD-T05-Q10.text: What does the label say? Read it, then tap the part that matches.

SCI-RD-T06-Q01.text: Read each word on the card, then drag it into the right group: living or non-living.

SCI-RD-T06-Q02.text: Two groups this time: food and toys. Read each word, decide where it belongs, and drag it there.

SCI-RD-T06-Q03.text: Sort these like a plant expert. Read each word and drag it to flowers or trees.

SCI-RD-T06-Q04.text: Where does each one live? Read every word, then drag it to lives in water or lives on land.

SCI-RD-T06-Q05.text: For each word, ask yourself: does this measure something? Read them, then drag each one to the right group.

SCI-RD-T06-Q06.text: Your two groups are predator and prey. Read each word carefully, then drag it where it belongs.

SCI-RD-T06-Q07.text: Cold or hot? Read each word on the card and drag it into the group that fits.

SCI-RD-T06-Q08.text: Think about size. Read each word, then drag it to small body of water or large body of water.

SCI-RD-T06-Q09.text: Pretend you're a zookeeper sorting name cards. Read each word, then drag it to mammal or not mammal.

SCI-RD-T06-Q10.text: Where does each one start? Read every word, then drag it to happens underground first or happens in the sky.

SCI-RD-T07-Q01.text: Read the three words on the card. Two belong together and one doesn't. Tap the odd one out.

SCI-RD-T07-Q02.text: Spot the one that doesn't fit. Read all three words, then tap the odd one out.

SCI-RD-T07-Q03.text: What do these words have in common? Read each one slowly, then tap the one that's different.

SCI-RD-T07-Q04.text: Three words, and one doesn't belong. Read them and tap the odd one out.

SCI-RD-T07-Q05.text: What do two of these words share that the third doesn't? Read them, then tap the odd one out.

SCI-RD-T07-Q06.text: Like a detective, look for the word that doesn't match the others. Read all three and tap it when you find it.

SCI-RD-T07-Q08.text: This one needs careful thinking. Read the three words, work out the pattern, and tap the one that breaks it.

SCI-RD-T07-Q09.text: Odd-one-out time. Read the three words, think hard about what each one is, then tap the one that doesn't belong.

SCI-RD-T07-Q10.text: Imagine three words at a party, and one doesn't quite fit in. Read them all, then tap the odd one out.

SCI-RD-T08-Q01.text: Read the steps on the card. Then drag them into the order they happen, from first to last.

SCI-RD-T08-Q02.text: What has to happen first? Read each step carefully, then put them all in order.

SCI-RD-T08-Q03.text: These steps are jumbled up. Read them, work out what happens first, next and last, and drag them into order.

SCI-RD-T08-Q04.text: Four steps, one right order. Read every step, then arrange them from start to finish.

SCI-RD-T08-Q05.text: Which step comes first, and which comes last? Read the card and drag the steps into the right order.

SCI-RD-T08-Q06.text: Slowly read through the steps. Then drag them into the order they would really happen.

SCI-RD-T08-Q07.text: Think about cause and effect: which step leads to the next? Read them all and put them in order.

SCI-RD-T08-Q08.text: Follow the journey. Read the steps on the card, then drag them so they go from the very first to the very last.

SCI-RD-T08-Q09.text: Imagine you're telling a story in the right order. Read each step on the card, then drag them from first to last.

SCI-RD-T08-Q10.text: How does one step lead to the next? Read them all, then drag them into the right order.

SCI-RD-T09-Q01.text: Read the cause on the card. What happens because of it? Tap the effect that fits.

SCI-RD-T09-Q02.text: Every cause has an effect. Read the cause carefully, then tap the result that would really happen.

SCI-RD-T09-Q03.text: Something happens on the card. Read it, think about what would come next, and tap that effect.

SCI-RD-T09-Q04.text: Picture the cause on the card actually happening. Which effect makes the most sense? Tap it.

SCI-RD-T09-Q05.text: Once you've read the cause, check each effect against what you know. Tap the one that follows.

SCI-RD-T09-Q06.text: Take your time reading the cause. When you've pictured it, tap the effect that matches.

SCI-RD-T09-Q07.text: Here's a cause to investigate. Read it, then tap the effect that would truly follow.

SCI-RD-T09-Q08.text: What would happen next? Read the card, then tap the effect you think is right.

SCI-RD-T09-Q09.text: Imagine the event on the card really happened. Read it, think about what would follow, and tap the effect.

SCI-RD-T09-Q10.text: Cause-and-effect challenge. Read the cause carefully, think it through, and tap the effect that would most likely happen.

SCI-RD-T10-Q01.text: The sentence on the card compares two things. Read it, then tap the choice that matches what it says.

SCI-RD-T10-Q02.text: Read the comparison on the card carefully, then tap the choice that agrees with it.

SCI-RD-T10-Q03.text: Read the sentence closely, word by word. Then tap the choice that says the same thing.

SCI-RD-T10-Q04.text: What is the card comparing? Read it, then tap the picture that fits.

SCI-RD-T10-Q05.text: Before you tap, read the sentence and look carefully at the words beside each picture.

SCI-RD-T10-Q06.text: In your own time, read the comparison. Then tap the choice that matches it.

SCI-RD-T10-Q07.text: Here's a comparison to decode. Read the card and tap the choice that tells the same thing.

SCI-RD-T10-Q08.text: As you read the card, picture the two things side by side. Which choice matches the sentence? Tap it.

SCI-RD-T10-Q09.text: This sentence compares several things in a row. Read it all the way through, then tap the choice that matches it.

SCI-RD-T10-Q10.text: Imagine lining things up on a shelf as you read. Read the whole sentence, then tap the choice it supports.

SCI-RD-T11-Q01.text: First read the question on the card, then read every word in the list. Tap all the ones that fit.

SCI-RD-T11-Q02.text: The card tells you what to look for. Read it, then go through the list and tap every word that matches.

SCI-RD-T11-Q03.text: What are you searching for? The card will tell you. Read it, check each word, and tap every one that fits.

SCI-RD-T11-Q04.text: More than one word can be right here. Read the card, then tap every word in the list that matches.

SCI-RD-T11-Q05.text: Read what the card asks for, then look at each word in turn. Tap all the ones that match.

SCI-RD-T11-Q06.text: Carefully read the card, then each choice. Tap every one that fits what the card asks.

SCI-RD-T11-Q07.text: Start by reading what the card wants. Then check every word one at a time, and tap all that belong.

SCI-RD-T11-Q08.text: Treasure hunt. Read the card to learn what you're hunting for, then tap every choice in the list that matches.

SCI-RD-T11-Q09.text: Pretend you're a scientist sorting your notes. Read the card, then tap every word in the list that fits.

SCI-RD-T11-Q10.text: Every word on this card matters. Read it closely, then go through the list and tap each choice that fits.

SCI-RD-T12-Q01.text: Read each science word and each meaning. Then match every word to the meaning that fits it.

SCI-RD-T12-Q02.text: Pair them up. Read the words and the meanings, then connect each word with what it means.

SCI-RD-T12-Q03.text: Which word does each meaning describe? Read them carefully and match them all up.

SCI-RD-T12-Q04.text: Three words, three meanings. Read them all, then match each word to the right meaning.

SCI-RD-T12-Q05.text: Can you match every word to the meaning that fits? Read them all first, then pair them up.

SCI-RD-T12-Q06.text: Take your time reading each meaning. Then match every word to the one that describes it.

SCI-RD-T12-Q07.text: Look for the clues that link each word to its meaning. Read everything, then match each pair.

SCI-RD-T12-Q08.text: Big science words ahead. Read each one and each meaning, then match them up in pairs.

SCI-RD-T12-Q09.text: Each word on the card is looking for its partner. Read them all, then pair every word with the meaning that fits it.

SCI-RD-T12-Q10.text: Go through each word and each meaning closely, then match every word to the meaning that fits it best.

SCI-RD-T13-Q01.text: There's a picture graph on the card. Count the symbols in each row, then read the question and tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T13-Q02.text: Look carefully at the picture graph. Count each row, then answer the question below it.

SCI-RD-T13-Q03.text: This graph question takes careful counting. Read the graph and the question, then tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T13-Q04.text: Be a data detective. Count the symbols, read the question closely, and tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T13-Q05.text: What does the graph show? Count the symbols in each row, then tap the answer to the question.

SCI-RD-T13-Q06.text: Compare the rows of the graph carefully. Then read the question and tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T13-Q07.text: Count every symbol in the graph, row by row. Then read the question and tap the answer you worked out.

SCI-RD-T13-Q08.text: Graph explorer time. Count each row of symbols, read the question, then tap the answer that fits.

SCI-RD-T13-Q09.text: This graph has a bit more to it. Read every part of the card carefully, then tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T13-Q10.text: Picture yourself as a scientist checking a tally chart. Read every part of the card, think it through, then tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T14-Q01.text: There's a short passage on the card. Read it carefully, then answer the question at the end by tapping your choice.

SCI-RD-T14-Q02.text: Read the passage in your own time. The answer is in the text, so look back at it if you need to.

SCI-RD-T14-Q03.text: First the passage, then the question. Look back through the text to find the answer, and tap it.

SCI-RD-T14-Q04.text: What does the passage tell you? Read it all the way through, then answer the question by tapping your choice.

SCI-RD-T14-Q05.text: Slowly work through the passage. Then read the question and tap the answer that matches what the passage says.

SCI-RD-T14-Q06.text: The details matter in this passage, so read it closely. Then tap the answer the passage supports.

SCI-RD-T14-Q07.text: Hunt through the passage for the sentence that answers the question. Then tap your choice.

SCI-RD-T14-Q08.text: This passage is a longer read. Take it one sentence at a time, then answer the question at the end.

SCI-RD-T14-Q09.text: Imagine you're reading a page from a scientist's notebook. Read it carefully, then tap the answer to the question.

SCI-RD-T14-Q10.text: This question asks about the big idea of the whole passage. Read every part, then tap the answer that sums it up.

SCI-RD-T15-Q01.text: Read the short story on the card like a detective. Use the clues to work out what must be true, then tap it.

SCI-RD-T15-Q02.text: Something happens in this short story. Read it, think about why, then tap the answer that makes sense.

SCI-RD-T15-Q03.text: What do the clues tell you happened? Read the story carefully, then tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T15-Q04.text: Notice what changes as you read the story. Then tap the answer the story suggests.

SCI-RD-T15-Q05.text: Look closely at the clues on the card. What do they suggest? Tap the answer they support best.

SCI-RD-T15-Q06.text: Evidence matters here. Read the story, think about what it really shows, and tap the answer it supports.

SCI-RD-T15-Q07.text: Imagine you're a detective on a science case. Read the card, think about what the clues suggest, and tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T15-Q08.text: Weigh up every clue in this story before you decide. Read the card carefully, then tap your answer.

SCI-RD-T15-Q09.text: Investigation time. Read every detail on the card, think about how they link together, then tap the most sensible answer.

SCI-RD-T15-Q10.text: What can you work out from the story on the card? Read it carefully, then tap the answer the evidence supports.
